title: Kubernetes inventory job parameters
description: The parameters of a kubernetes_inventory job. All optional. The job always describes the cluster the agent runs in, through the agent's own service account: it carries no credentials, and parameters that would name another cluster or supply a credential make the job invalid. No parameter turns on reading TLS Secrets.

classes.description: Collect only these classes; the others answer unsupported, not_requested. Default: all. `cluster` is always collected.

probe_kubelets.description: Handshake with each node's kubelet port. Default true.

include_certificate_pem.description: Send certificate_pem with each certificate. Default true.

traefik.description: Also read Traefik's IngressRoutes, IngressRouteTCPs, TLSOptions and TLSStores (traefik.io and traefik.containo.us) and answer the traefik section. Default false: without it the result has no Traefik member, so a platform that does not know them is sent what it always was. An agent that does not know this parameter ignores it and sends no traefik section.

extra_label_keys.description: Label keys to report in addition to the built-in allowlist.
